steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: x = r cos θ, y = r sin θ; r = sqrt(x^2+y^2), tan θ = y/x (check quadrant)

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: r = a (circle centred at origin), r = 2a cos θ (circle on x-axis), r = 2a sin θ (circle on y-axis)

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: r = a(1 + cos θ) (cardioid), r = a cos(nθ) (n-petal rose if n odd, 2n-petal if n even)

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: r = aθ (Archimedean spiral), r^2 = a^2 cos 2θ (lemniscate)

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: Find the area enclosed by one petal of r = 2 cos 3θ --- Solution: r = 0 when cos 3θ = 0 -> 3θ = pi/2 -> θ = pi/6. One petal from -pi/6 to pi/6. Area = ½∫_{-pi/6}^{pi/6} (2 cos 3θ)^2 dθ = 2∫_{-pi/6}^{pi/6} cos^2 3θ dθ = ∫(1+cos 6θ) dθ = [θ + ⅙ sin 6θ]_{-pi/6}^{pi/6} = pi/3

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Convert r = 2 sin θ to Cartesian, identify the curve | Sketch r = 1 + 2 cos θ | Area inside r = 2 and outside r = 1 + cos θ
